tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Outermost page behind the editor window.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Window chrome: menubar, workspace bar, panel headers, status bar, graph node headers.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel bodies and graph node bodies. The default surface for content.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Raised controls on panel: buttons, component headers in Inspector, active tab chip, hover rows.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Inset fields: text inputs, selects, button groups, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px seams between panels (window background shows through a 1px gap) and input borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons, nodes and modals that sit on panel.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on panel, win, raise and sunk.

tokens.name: fg-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, inactive tabs, type columns. Reads on panel and win (about 5:1).

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text, section captions, gutters. Below 3:1 on panel: never for text a person must read, only labels repeated elsewhere.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one highlight: active tab top border, selection outline, primary button, focus ring, playhead. Never decoration.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: active state chips, Forge-native badge, highlighted code line.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, active play button).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected row background in Hierarchy, Project and lists.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: gizmo arrow, X label on vector fields.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis: gizmo arrow, Y label on vector fields.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis: gizmo arrow, Z label on vector fields.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state: saved dot, compiled check, OK log level. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state: WARN log level, budget bar over limit. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error state: ERROR log level, failed compile, record button. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: prefab
tokens.usage: Prefab instance names and the override marker bar in Inspector.

tokens.name: pin-bool

tokens.name: pin-object
tokens.usage: Graph GameObject and component reference pins and wires.

tokens.name: pin-ui
tokens.usage: UI widgets in trees, anim notify keyframes, widget space labels.
